sections.text_helper: Section 32.6.20 "ADC analog watchdog 3 configuration register (ADC_AWD3CR)" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1562.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0A4
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:0 AWDCH[19:0]: Analog watchdog 3 channel selection
These bits are set and cleared by software. They enable and select the input channels to be guarded
by the analog watchdog 3.
AWDCH[i] = 0: ADC analog input channel i is not monitored by AWD3
AWDCH[i] = 1: ADC analog input channel i is monitored by AWD3
When AWDCH[19:0] = 000..0, the analog Watchdog 3 is disabled.
Note: The channels selected by AWDCH must be also selected in the SQi or JSQi bits.
Note: The software is allowed to write these bits only when ADSTART=0 and JADSTART=0 (which
ensures that no conversion is ongoing).
Note: Some channels are not connected physically and must not be selected for the analog
watchdog.
